scope: All raid tab transitions, Core overview, full-height raid shell, duplicate navigation controls
userRequests: 붕괴 코어 진입 시 축소 배치가 풀림
검은색 여백 없이 꽉 차게 만들고 중복 버튼 제거
causes: Compact shared navigation was restricted to the visible World lobby, so other raid tabs reverted to the 220px horizontal tab minimums.
Shared lobby header scrolled outside the visible area while its measured 86px height remained reserved above the raid route.
Raid route heading duplicated Home/All menu from the persistent rail or mobile dock, with another destination toolbar above the same tabs.
changes: Scope the shared compact navigation to the raid hub; preserve full-width World battlefield explicitly.
Scale Core overview and room browser to the available container; maintain usable mobile reward text.
Expose three named shadow parts on the existing shared lobby; only the active raid hides its header, clears its reserved space, and fills its frame.
Keep Home/content menu in the persistent rail or mobile dock; hide duplicate raid route header and the extra destination/card-evolution toolbar.
Skip Core polling when its view is no longer connected/visible, including visibility-change resume.
Refresh root/H5 cache tags and generated lobby resources.

verification.design: Impeccable CSS final: no findings. The HTML detector reports an unchanged source-less avatar img that the existing component hides or assigns at runtime; all rendered checks report zero missing assets.

performance.condition: Windows host, headless Chrome. Desktop 1280x650/1024x600/960x540/800x600; Android touch emulation 390x844/360x640/320x568/844x390; Windows entry URL and H5 iframe host. SQLite/PGlite raid handlers are isolated local fixtures. Local baseline serves commit 7e21ca548; screenshots use fixture accounts/settings.
performance.loading: First Core tab and repeated Core tab are timed separately from the automated input command through a visible action and fonts-ready. Includes automation click stability and local request/render latency. Same-condition single samples, not physical-device or production server benchmarks.
performance.bottleneck: The reproduced space loss was layout reservation, not server wait. No startup/network speed improvement is claimed; the generated lobby gains only three part attributes. The observed recurring hidden Core API request after leaving was removed.
performance.frameInterpretation: 650ms requestAnimationFrame scroll samples; max/p95 and >50ms counts are recorded. Headless intervals are not physical screen FPS.
performance.exit: After a 300ms settle, the following 5.3s window had one Core status call before and zero after; no raid canvas remained.
